The difference $A-B$ consists of all the elements that are in $A$ but not $B.$ To represent $A-B,$ we will shade in all the area that is contained in $A$ but not $B.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14037357/assets/bc49e8015fa86dc52451411569e920b5beb17bf88e148644cfca8a9c7ba5ca64.png)

The elements $1,3,12$ are in $A$ but not $B.$

Therefore, the difference is

$$
A-B={1,3,12}.
$$
